Is it better to focus on one platform deeply or spread across several early on?

Early on, depth on one platform usually beats breadth across several — splitting limited time and energy too thin often means mediocre presence everywhere instead of a real foothold anywhere. Which platform are you leaning toward as your primary?

The first real signal is separating revenue from profit - a lot of creators look successful because gross income is high, but after platform fees, equipment, editing tools, and time cost, the actual margin can be thin or negative. Second, track income consistency over several months rather than judging off a single good month, since one viral spike doesn't establish a sustainable baseline. Third, look at diversification - income concentrated entirely in one platform or one revenue stream is fragile even if the numbers look fine today, since a single policy change can wipe it out. Sustainable creator businesses usually show steady, diversified, and realistically-costed income, not just a big headline number.
